text: Final categorization: POSSIBLE (Justification: The paper is a non-review research article that uses projected changes in coastal habitat area (a form of land cover) from 1900 to 2060 as input data for carbon sequestration and valuation analysis. These LULC projections are not the primary focus of the study but are derived from existing literature and expert judgment (e.g., JNCC, Hansom et al.) to support ecosystem service valuation. The study does not develop or implement a spatial LULC prediction model itself, nor does it include mapped LULC projections, quantitative accuracy metrics, or explicit national-scale spatial modeling of land cover change. Instead, habitat area trends are used as an input step to calculate carbon stocks and economic values. Thus, while future LULC scenarios are used (two scenarios: maintained vs. continued loss), they are secondary to the core objective of carbon valuation, meeting the definition of 'POSSIBLE'. The paper also fails several core inclusion criteria: no spatially explicit LULC modeling, no mapped outputs, and no accuracy assessment of land cover projections.)
